info.description: High-performance Go backend for the Chanom Twitter clone.
info.title: Twitter Go API

post.description: Interact with the Gemini-powered AI assistant. Streams Server-Sent Events: each `data:` line is a JSON `{"text": "..."}` chunk; the stream ends with `event: done`, or `event: error` with `{"message": "..."}`.
Exchange a Google ID token for a session. The access and refresh tokens are set as httpOnly cookies.
End this browser's session and clear its cookies. Other devices stay signed in.

get.description: Fetch the profile of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Rotate the session in the refresh_token cookie: both cookies are replaced and the old refresh token stops working.

get.description: Get a list of currently trending hashtags based on recent usage.
Get a paginated list of suggested users to follow.

One Server-Sent Events stream per signed-in tab. Event names: `connected`, `notification` (NotificationResponse), `dm` (MessageResponse). Comment lines (`: ping`) are heartbeats. Reconnect on close; the server suggests a 3s retry.
Get a paginated list of tweets from users the current user follows.
Get a paginated list of all tweets.
Reports that the process is up. Never checks dependencies, so a database blip doesn't get the container restarted.
Get a paginated list of the current user's conversations.
Get a paginated list of messages in a specific conversation.

post.description: Send a message to an existing conversation thread.
Start a new conversation or send a message to a user by their ID.

get.description: Get a paginated list of social notifications (likes, follows, etc.) for the current user.

post.description: Clear all unread notification badges for the current user.

get.description: Calculate how many unread notifications the current user has.
Checks every dependency (database, and Redis when configured) and reports each one.
Find trending or specific hashtags matching a prefix.
Search for tweets by content (using full-text search) with pagination.
Search for users by username or display name with pagination.

post.description: Post a new tweet with optional text and media.

get.description: Fetch a single tweet by its ID.

delete.description: Remove a tweet by ID. Only the author can delete their own tweet.

post.description: Add a like to a tweet.

delete.description: Remove a like from a tweet.

get.description: Get a paginated list of replies to a specific tweet.

post.description: Share a tweet on your own profile.
Generate a temporary presigned URL to upload a file directly to S3. The upload must use exactly the declared Content-Type and Content-Length.

get.description: Look a profile up by handle (case-insensitive).

post.description: Choose a username (3-20 letters, numbers or underscores) and display name. Sign-up assigns a generated username until then.

put.description: Modify the display name, bio, or profile images of the authenticated user.

get.description: Get public profile information for a user by their ID.

post.description: Establish a following relationship with another user.

get.description: Get a paginated list of users following the specified user.
Get a paginated list of users followed by the specified user.
Tweets the user liked, most recently liked first. Only the user themselves may list their likes.
A user's tweets that carry an image or video, newest first.
A user's top-level tweets and retweets, newest first.
Replies written by a user, newest first.

onboarded.description: Onboarded is false until the user has chosen their own username.

checks.description: Checks maps each dependency to "ok" or "error"; failure details are logged, not exposed.

retweetedBy.description: RetweetedBy is set when the tweet is in a timeline because this user retweeted it.

BearerAuth.description: Type 'Bearer ' followed by an access token. Browsers use the httpOnly access_token cookie instead.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
